name: clash-verge-controller
title: Clash Verge Controller
description: Control Clash Verge from Raycast: switch proxies, set modes, test latency, and refresh subscriptions.

commands.name: switch-proxy
commands.title: Switch Proxy
commands.subtitle: Clash Verge
commands.description: Toggle nodes and modes for Clash Verge.

preferences.name: controllerUrl
preferences.title: Controller URL
preferences.description: The URL of your Clash controller

preferences.name: secret
preferences.title: External Controller Secret
preferences.description: Access secret for Clash external controller (leave empty if not set)

preferences.name: proxyGroup
preferences.title: Selector Group Name
preferences.description: Name of the proxy selector group

preferences.name: speedTestTimeout
preferences.title: Speed Test Timeout (ms)
preferences.description: Timeout for speed test in milliseconds

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
